autopsy.definition: close 30%+ above the lowest close of the 10 sessions before it; start = the session after that close; universe at the base close: price >= 1 USD, median 20-day dollar volume >= 2M USD; one episode per stock per 10 sessions; moves with a split inside dropped
autopsy.catchableRule: still 15%+ from the next open after the first close 10%+ above the base, to the best close of the 10-session window

flagTable.text: close above its 50-day average
close above its 200-day average
close 20%+ below its 200-day average
within 10% of its 52-week high close
40%+ below its 6-month high close
last 10 closes within an 8% range
last 10 closes spread over 25%+
6+ of the last 10 sessions closed up
3 or fewer of the last 10 sessions closed up
today's volume 2x+ the 20-day average
last 5 days volume 1.5x+ the 20 days before
last 5 days volume 0.7x or less of the 20 days before
up 10%+ in the last 5 sessions
down 10%+ in the last 5 sessions
up 10%+ in 20 sessions with no single day over 35% of the gain
a one-day gain of 15%+ in the last 20 sessions
earnings report due in the next 5 sessions
earnings reported in the last 10 sessions
an 8-K filed in the last 10 sessions
an S-1 / S-3 / F-1 / F-3 / 424B filed in the last 30 sessions
a 13D (5%+ holder with intent) filed in the last 30 sessions
2+ Form 4 insider filings in the last 10 sessions
its industry beat the S&P 500 by 5%+ over 20 sessions
its industry trailed the S&P 500 by 5%+ over 20 sessions
S&P 500 above its 50-day average
price under 5 USD
market value under 300M USD
daily moves 6%+ (20-day standard deviation)

insider.note: insider purchase filings known up to 2026-09-30

registered.text: last 10 closes spread over 25%+ AND down 10%+ in the last 5 sessions AND daily moves 6%+ (20-day standard deviation)
40%+ below its 6-month high close AND last 10 closes spread over 25%+ AND daily moves 6%+ (20-day standard deviation)
40%+ below its 6-month high close AND down 10%+ in the last 5 sessions AND daily moves 6%+ (20-day standard deviation)
